breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory definitions for the factor of safety. The agent correctly ignored the incorrect definition (n = σ_avg / S_y) and instead used the correct one (n = S_y / σ_avg), which is the one specified in the ground truth prompt. The generated output correctly calculates the factor of safety using this formula.
